conflict.accepted_surface: DefaultTargetDto and Routing UI include followActiveSubscription, Pool, Direct and Block.
conflict.current_authority: SingBoxCompiler::compile rejects every non-Pool default target before emitting final_outbound.
conflict.executable_sequence: Save default Direct or Block succeeds and advances desired generation; Apply projects the exact target; compile rejects it; the user can never apply the saved choice.

recommended_amendment.decision: Allow the smallest Compiler change required to map default Pool to pool tag, Direct to direct, Block to block, while Unconfigured remains rejected before compilation.
limits: No new wire variant, schema, dependency, runtime mode or general Compiler refactor.
Route compilation and all existing security validation remain unchanged.
Add exact positive tests for Direct and Block final_outbound plus rejection of Unconfigured and missing Pool.

scope: Map default Pool(existing) to its pool-* runtime tag.
Adjust final outbound validation only to accept a valid Pool tag, direct, or block.
limits: Do not accept arbitrary node or outbound tags as route.final.
Do not modify RuntimeIntent, RouteTarget, StoredState/schema, wire contract, tag rules, runtime mode, dependencies, or Compiler structure.
Cover exact Pool, Direct, and Block route.final values; Unconfigured and missing Pool rejection; and the persisted Direct/Block projection-to-Compiler path.

alternative: Amend the frozen DefaultTarget contract and UI to remove Direct and Block from default selection; this narrows an already approved product capability and is not recommended.
